chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abi Ayyub al-Khazzaz, who said:
I asked Aba Ja'far عليه السلام about a man who struck a slave belonging to him, and he died from his beating. He said: "He must free a slave."

key_terms.رَقَبَةً: a slave, meaning a person to be freed as expiation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man beats his slave and the slave dies from the beating?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a master whose slave dies as a result of his beating. Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام rules that expiation in this case is the freeing of a slave, highlighting accountability for causing death through violence.
